attributes.name: live
attributes.doc: Live validation (on by default); `:live="false"` turns it off.

attributes.name: target
attributes.doc: A selector the answer is swapped into.

attributes.name: swap
attributes.doc: How the answer is swapped in.

attributes.name: button
attributes.doc: Whether to draw the opening button.

attributes.name: @opened
attributes.doc: Runs when the component sends opened.

attributes.name: @closed
attributes.doc: Runs when the component sends closed.

attributes.name: @saved
attributes.doc: Runs when the component sends saved.

attributes.name: @failed
attributes.doc: Runs when the component sends failed.

tags.name: rx-event-stream
tags.doc: Opens the notifications stream on a page without the bell, so `state.broadcast(...)` events arrive as DOM events.

tags.name: rx-mail
tags.doc: A mail's layout: `{% extends %}` of the mail layout, with its content and footer.

attributes.name: layout
attributes.doc: The layout's file name; renox/mail/layout.html by default. Plain text.

tags.name: rx-mail-text
tags.doc: A mail's plain-text version (a `.txt` view): the text as written, with `{{ }}`, `rx-if` and `rx-for` (on a `<template>`).

tags.name: rx-mail-button
tags.doc: A button for a mail, with its address written under it for clients that hide buttons.

attributes.name: label
attributes.doc: (required) The label; or give it as content.

tags.name: rx-mail-panel
tags.doc: A highlighted box in a mail.

tags.name: rx-mail-table
tags.doc: A table for a mail: rows of cells, an optional heading and an optional total row.

attributes.name: :rows
attributes.doc: (required) The rows: a list of lists of cells.

attributes.name: :total
attributes.doc: The last row's cells, drawn in bold.

tags.name: rx-mail-divider
tags.doc: A thin line between parts of a mail.

global_attributes.name: rx-if
global_attributes.doc: Renders the element only when the expression is true.

global_attributes.name: rx-elif
global_attributes.doc: Renders the element when the preceding rx-if (or rx-elif) was false and this expression is true.

global_attributes.name: rx-else
global_attributes.doc: Renders the element when the preceding rx-if was false.

global_attributes.name: can
global_attributes.doc: Renders the element only when the user may do this (a gate or an ability).
